violations.text: Inspector observed handwashing sink in back kitchen area in poor repair (disconnected from plumbing below). New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Inspector observed packages of tortilla without labels. Staff did not know where tortillas came from, but suspected from someone's home. PIC discarded and denatured tortillas. Owner informed to purchase from licensed establishments. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Eggs, cooked onions, ham, and salami were observed held between 89-103 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Eggs were observed held at 51 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed eggs in another fridge for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Juice packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Unpasteurized juice must also contain the following warning statement: WARNING: This product has not been pasteurized and therefore may contain harmful bacteria that can cause serious illness in children, the elderly, and persons with weakened immune systems. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings on retail shelf and back kitchen area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The door to the outside, located on the side (near dumpster), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
Per owner, establishment has cat in basement area. Inspector informed owner that the cat needs to be removed from establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the air vents of open case cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The non-food contact surfaces of the retail shelves (ramen and flour) have an accumulation of rodent droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Inspector observed boxes and trash build up around dumpster area. Oil receptacle has an accumulation of grease and debris on top. Establishment to keep area clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The walk-in cooler fan blades, ceiling, and walls have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
The ceiling tiles in the cashier area are in poor repair (previous water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer, blender, meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025

Various items were observed held between 52-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/01/2025

Various items (ham, cheese, cooked meat) were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the service line area. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Cardboard is used in the construction of shelf liners in the retail area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of a knife handle has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025
Service line is missing an allergen statement for customers. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

The service line does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The hand-washing sinks throughout the establishment are lacking proper handwashing signs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Raw animal foods (such as raw meat and eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as produce and cooked meat) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Rice and chicken, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC disposed. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Various items were observed held between 98-122 degrees Fahrenheit (steam table was off). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated items. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Juice and cake packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the service line area. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Cardboard is used in the construction of shelf liner in the retail area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sinks. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Drying racks are needed at both 3 bay sinks (kitchen and service areas). Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -walk-in fan blades, -flat top grill table, -blender base. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Service line is missing allergen statement for customers. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

The kitchen AND service line does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking proper hand washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Raw animal foods (such as chicken and eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as milk and beef) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC rearranged items. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer, knives, ban saw, meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took items out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Beans, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Fried chicken was observed held at 94 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Deli meat and cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Yogurt parfit and juice packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Food items were observed stored on the floor in the retail, walk-in, and basement areas. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Inspector observed several items being stored in the mop sink. PIC informed all equipment must be cleaned and sanitized and properly stored to prevent contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the service line area. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

Cardboard is used to line shelves in the retail area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Drying racks are needed at both 3 bay sinks (kitchen and service area). New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sinks. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris:-stove top,-walk-in cooler shelves, -walk-in cooler fan blades,-flat top grill table,-blender base. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Plumbing to the 3 bay sink in the service area is in poor repair. Inspector observed a leak. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

The walls in the kitchen (near prep table) and floors (in the retail area) are constructed of wood. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
